title: Bear Lake to Emerald Lake
map_label: A 3D walk from Bear Lake past Nymph and Dream Lakes to Emerald Lake.

stops.file: Bear Lake Trailhead, Estes Park, United States (Unsplash).jpg
stops.title: Bear Lake Trailhead
stops.alt: The Bear Lake trailhead sign in Rocky Mountain National Park.
stops.text: The route starts at Bear Lake, about 9,450 feet up in Rocky Mountain National Park.

stops.title: Dream Lake
stops.alt: Dream Lake below the peaks of Rocky Mountain National Park.
stops.text: The trail passes Nymph Lake and then Dream Lake, with Hallett Peak above.

stops.title: Emerald Lake
stops.alt: Emerald Lake at the foot of Hallett Peak and Flattop Mountain.
stops.text: You have reached Emerald Lake, tucked under the cliffs of Hallett Peak.
